edit.description: retitle the commitPaths empty-path case; pin the injected rejection in the locale-independence case

summary: Title commitPaths' empty-path case for the rejection it asserts; pin that the locale-independence case's injected git rejection reached deleteBranch

per.section: A green verdict is proven non-vacuous

acceptance: Neither case in tests/git.test.ts claims a subject its body leaves unexercised: the empty-path title names a rejection, and the locale case asserts the mock fired before its verdict.
pins: commitPaths rejects when no paths are supplied
deleteBranch no-ops on a missing branch whose git rejection carries non-English stderr
notes: tests/git.test.ts:265 titles 'throws synchronously' over a body asserting .rejects; commitPaths is async (src/git.ts:594) so the throw can only reject. tests/git.test.ts:958 asserts resolves-undefined alone — its node:child_process mock matches show-ref argv at index 3, and if that argv drifts the mock stops firing, the real probe exits 1, and the case stays green over English stderr. Sibling cases in this file (cherryPickAbort's gitPathProbes, the colon-path probe) already carry such a pin.
